The '''Fed-Dub Stretch''' was a canyon of the [[Mephyt River|Krisa River]] valley, located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. Named after the [[Federation of the Double Worlds|Fed-Dub]], it directly led to the city of [[Nashal]]. The Fed-Dub Stretch was used as a racetrack for the [[Nashal River Race]].<ref name="SWG:NRT" />
